legalConnect: This app connects to a server its owner runs. What's on that server is theirs, not the WittyMediaServer project's: the project, its contributors and affiliates don't provide, host, endorse or check it.
findSearching: Looking for servers on your network…
findNone: No servers found on your network yet.
findNotSupported: This device can't search your network. Enter your server's address instead.
addressHint: It looks like 192.168.1.20 or https://media.example.com. WittyMediaServer shows it when it starts.
errScheme: That isn't a web address. Use something like 192.168.1.20.
errCredentials: Leave out the name and password. You'll sign in on the next screen.
errInvalid: That doesn't look like an address. It should look like 192.168.1.20.
errPublicHttp: That address is on the internet, and your password would travel unencrypted. Use an https:// address instead.
errUnreachable: Can't reach a server there. Check the address, and that WittyMediaServer is running and this device is on the same network.
errNotServer: Something answered at that address, but it isn't WittyMediaServer.
errLost: Lost contact with your server. Check that it is running, then try again.
setupNeededTitle: This server isn't set up yet
setupNeededDetail: Finish setup in a web browser at the address below. The app can connect once it is done.
errNotSetUp: That server hasn't been set up yet. Open its address in a web browser to finish setting it up.
errServerOld: That server is too old for this app. Update WittyMediaServer, then try again.
errAppOld: This server needs a newer version of this app.
errCertificate: That server's security certificate can't be trusted, so nothing was sent to it.
pairHint: On a phone or computer already signed in, open this address and type the code:
pairScan: Or scan this with your phone:
pairPinHint: Type this PIN where you approve it. It changes every 30 seconds.
notKept: This device couldn't keep your sign-in safely, so you'll be asked to sign in again next time.
showCodeInstead: Show a code on this screen instead
codeHint: On a phone or computer signed in to this server, open Sign in a TV (under You, or under your name in the corner on the web) and get a code there.
identityTitle: This isn't the server you used before
identityHint: A different machine is answering at this address. It could be your server after a reinstall, or a look-alike. Only trust it if you know why it changed.
identityTrust: This is my server, trust it
identityBad: This server couldn't prove who it is, so nothing was sent to it.
identityChanged: This server's identity changed while you were on this screen, so nothing was sent to it. Check the new fingerprint before carrying on.
findSubtitle: Pick one you've used, one on this network, or connect from anywhere.
twoFactorTitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app
twoFactorHint: Your account asks for a second step. Open your authenticator app and type the six digits it shows for this server.
openOnPhone: Open this on a phone or computer:
errWrongPassword: That password isn't right. Try again.
errWrongNameOrPassword: That name or password isn't right. Try again.
errWrongCode: That code isn't right. Use the newest one your authenticator app shows.
useAuthenticatorCode: Use the code from your app
recoveryHint: Lost your phone? Type one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on the second step. Each one works once.
errWrongRecovery: That recovery code isn't right, or it has been used already.
gamesNoneDetail: This server has no games library. An owner adds one in Settings on the server's website.
liveTvNoneDetail: This server has no TV channels. An owner sets them up in Settings on the server's website.
librariesNoneDetail: An owner adds them in Settings on the server's website.
lookHint: How this app is arranged and finished on this device: the menu, the cards, the type. Theme is chosen separately.
lookNone: This server has no looks to choose from.
themeImportHint: A theme file (ZIP). It works with every look.
firstLookDetail: Each look is a layout of its own: the menu, Home and the cards, drawn as they are on this device. Colours are the next step, and you can change both any time in Settings.
firstThemeDetail: The colours. Any theme goes with any look: here is yours in each.
profileNameHint: What everyone sees on this server's profiles. Leave it empty to use your username.
usernameHint: What you type to sign in.
usernameKidsHint: Only an adult can change this profile's names.
showUsernameHint: Next to your picture in the server's own pages, in place of your profile name.
errUsernameEmpty: Type a username. It's what you sign in with.
passwordChangeHint: At least 8 characters. Your other devices will be signed out.
errPasswordsDiffer: The two new passwords aren't the same.
twoStepIntro: Ask for a code from an authenticator app as well as your password, so a password on its own can't get in.
twoStepUnavailable: This server can't offer two-step sign-in yet.
twoStepScanTitle: Add this server to your authenticator app
twoStepScanHint: Scan the code with the app, or type the key. Then enter the six digits it shows.
twoStepOpenApp: Open in an authenticator app on this phone
twoStepSavedHint: If you lose your phone, each of these signs you in once. Keep them somewhere safe: this is the only time they're shown.
twoStepTurnOffHint: Enter your password and a code from your authenticator app.
devicesHint: Everywhere you're signed in. Sign out of anything you don't recognise.
signOutOthersConfirm: Sign out everywhere except this device?
signInTvHint: Type the code your TV shows.
signInTvDone: The TV is signing in now.
signInTvInvite: The TV asks for a code?
signInTvInviteHint: Type this on the TV. It works once, for {minutes} minutes.
signInTvAdultOnly: An adult profile has to do this.
themeHint: Only on this device. The server's own pages in the app follow it too.
topMenuHint: Only on this TV. Libraries you tick here go in the menu along the top, after Search.
themeAutomaticHint: Light or dark, as this device is set
pairBusy: This server has given this device a lot of codes lately. Wait a few minutes for a new one, or sign in with a password now.
themeWebOnly: Some themes add pictures and effects that only the website can show; their colours still come across.
wpMultiplayerLater: Play with someone on another server. Coming later.
wpRewindHint: Let go to play from here
wpLayoutResetAsk: Put this layout back as it came? Your arrangement for {console} on {shape} goes.
inviteHint: Away from home? Paste an invite link from your server's Remote Access page here instead.
errInvite: That invite link isn't right. Ask for a new one from your server's Remote Access page.
errInviteRefused: Your server didn't accept that invite. Invites work once and last fifteen minutes: ask for a new one.
errAwayMissing: This copy of the app can't connect from away: its connection helper is missing. Reinstall the app.
errAwayFailed: Couldn't reach your server from away. It may be off, or peer-to-peer connections may be turned off on it.
awayHint: How this device reaches your server when it isn't at home: peer to peer, with nothing set up on the router.
awayStopConfirm: This device comes off your server's list and stops adding itself to it. You can turn it back on here.
awayReadyHint: This device is on your server's list. Away from home it finds the server by itself, and you stay signed in. A connection through a relay is always said to be one.
awaySetUpHint: Turn on peer-to-peer connections on your server, under Remote Access. This device adds itself to the list the next time it is at home and signed in.
awayAtHome: That server is on this network. Choose it from the list instead.
awayNotHere: This device can't connect from away.
anywhereHint: Reach your server over the internet with a private peer to peer connection, with nothing to set up on your router.
anywherePicture: This device connects to your server over an encrypted connection.
anywhereJoinLink: Join with a link or code
anywhereShowCode: Show a code to type in
inviteTitle: Join with a link or code
inviteLead: Paste the invite link your server's owner sent you. It works once, for a short time, and connects peer to peer from anywhere.
joinAwayHint: For a device that has never been at home with your server. On a phone or computer signed in to it, open Settings, Remote Access, find “A TV that shows a code”, and type this in:
joinAwayExpired: Nobody typed that code in before it ran out. Get a new one.
joinAwayRefused: Your server didn't accept that code. Get a new one.
awayOffHint: Turned off on this device. It isn't on your server's list, and doesn't add itself to it.
manageServersHint: Servers this device has used. Removing one takes it off this device only: nothing on the server itself is deleted, and you can add it again at any time.
savedServersFirstHint: Servers this device has used are listed above the ones found on your network, the last one used first.
removeConfirmBody: This device will forget {name} at {address}: its address, the proof of who it is, your sign-in to it, and everything this app kept from it. Nothing on the server itself is deleted.
removeConfirmInUse: You're using this server now, so you'll be signed out of it here.
removeAllBody: This device will forget every server it has used ({count}): {names}. For each one that means its address, the proof of who it is, your sign-in to it, and everything this app kept from it. Nothing on the servers themselves is deleted.
removeOldTitle: Remove servers not reached for a while
removeOldHint: Choose how long. You'll see which servers that is before anything is removed.
removeOldNone: Every server here was reached more recently than that.
removeOldConfirmBody: Not reached for {period} or more ({count}): {names}. This device will forget each one's address, the proof of who it is, your sign-in to it, and everything this app kept from it. Nothing on the servers themselves is deleted.
lastReachedUnknown: Not reached since this app was updated
reinstalledHint: If your server was reinstalled, this app sees it as a different server. You can remove the old one from this device, then add this one as new.
removedOldOne: The old server was removed. Choose this one again to add it as new.
pairQrHint: On a phone that's already signed in, open You, then Sign in a TV, and scan the code. Then type the PIN shown here.
pairQrOrType: Or open {address} and type {code}, then the PIN.
pairQrScanApp: Scan with the WittyMediaClient app: You, then Sign in a TV.
pairQrScanCamera: Scan with your phone's camera, sign in, and type the PIN.
pairLocked: Too many wrong PINs were typed, so that sign-in was stopped.
approveHintScan: Scan the code your TV shows, or type its letters.
approveOrType: or type the letters it shows
approveScanning: Point the camera at the code on the TV.
approveCameraWhy: The camera is used only to read the code on the TV's screen. Nothing is recorded, kept or sent anywhere.
approveCameraDenied: The camera isn't allowed, so the code can't be scanned. Type the letters the TV shows instead. You can allow the camera in this device's settings.
approveCameraFailed: The camera couldn't be used. Type the letters the TV shows instead.
approveCheck: Only say yes if this is the device in front of you.
approvePasswordWhy: Signing a device in as an administrator asks for your password again.
pairQrOtherServer: That code is for another server, so nothing was sent. Scan the code on a device that's signing in to this one.
pairQrNotOurs: That isn't a sign-in code. Scan the code on the TV's sign-in screen.
switchPinHint: Type this profile's password or PIN.
timeUpPlain: This profile can't watch any more right now.
timeUpAgainTomorrow: You can watch again tomorrow at {time}.
askParentHint: A parent can give this profile more time today.
pictureHint: Your picture shows wherever your name does, on every device.
profilesHint: The Kids profiles you manage: their names and pictures, their limits, and what they watched.
profilesHintAdmin: Everyone on this server: their names and pictures, their limits, and what they watched.
profilesNone: There's nobody here for you to manage. An administrator manages everyone, and an adult manages Kids profiles.
profilesNoneLimited: An account with limits of its own can't manage other profiles.
profileLookHint: What they're called around the app, what they sign in with, and their picture.
profileUsernameHint: The username is what they sign in with. It has to be theirs alone.
profileReportHint: What they watched, what was refused, and more time
profileNotYours: That profile isn't one you manage.
profilesOnServer: Add or remove profiles, and passwords
limitsAdminHint: An administrator sees and does everything.
limitsHint: The server applies every limit, on every device. Nothing changes until you save.
limitsUnrated: Also show titles without a rating
limitsKinds: A different age for some kinds
limitsKindsHint: Films, TV, games, music and books are rated by different boards. Each can have its own limit, shown with what it allows in each country's ratings.
limitsLibrariesHint: Choose none to allow every library.
limitsOnlyGenresHint: Choose none to show every genre that isn't hidden.
limitsCollectionsHint: Allow or hide everything in a collection, whatever its rating. A collection made from a rule can't be used: it has no list of titles to go by.
limitsCollectionsNone: There are no collections yet. Make one under Collections, add titles to it, and it can be allowed or hidden here as a whole.
limitsTagsHint: For video libraries with tags. Commas between them.
limitsExceptionsHint: Always allow or never allow one film or show, whatever its rating. Never allow wins.
feature_games_hint: Play games here or on a game PC. Off hides game libraries too.
feature_recordings_hint: Record programmes and keep recording rules.
feature_downloads_hint: Save a copy of a photo or video to their device.
feature_sharing_hint: Make links that open a photo, video or album without signing in.
feature_comments_kids: Read comments. Kids and Guest profiles never write them.
feature_remote_hint: Off keeps this profile to your home network: it is signed out everywhere else.
feature_editProfile: Change their own name and picture
feature_editProfile_hint: Their username and password stay with whoever manages them.
limitsLibraryChannels: Channels made from this server's libraries
limitsTunerChannels: Antenna, cable and internet TV channels
timeHint: Time is counted by the server while this profile is playing something, on any device. When it runs out, what is playing stops and the profile is told why. A parent can give more.
timeNotHere: This server doesn't have screen time.
timeFromHint: Leave empty for no earliest time. With a bedtime and nothing here, the day starts at 6:00.
timeHolidays: Leave a time empty for none. School holidays aren't known to the server: change these when they start.
timeErrMinutes: Minutes a day must be between 0 and 1440.
timeErrNotTime: Write times of day as four digits, such as 07:00 or 20:30.
timeErrBedtime: Bedtime has to be later in the day than the earliest time.
limitsLeaveHint: The changes you made here haven't been saved.
reportHint: Kept only for profiles with limits. They can't see or clear it.
reportNothingHint: Nothing has been written down yet.
reportRefused: What was refused, and extra time
reportExtra: Was given more time: {n} minutes, by {who}
reportTime: Tried to play when time was up: {why}
reportWhy_allowance: the day's time was used up
reportFeature: Tried something that is turned off: {what}
reportClearHint: What they watched and what was refused is forgotten. Today's screen time stays.
parentsPinHint: When a profile's screen time runs out, a parent can type this PIN on that device to give it more time today. It does nothing else, so it can be short.
parentsPinStateNone: No PIN is set: a parent's own username and password work instead.
parentsPinAdminOnly: An administrator sets the parents' PIN.
playingHereHint: Only on this device. What a video skips by itself, and whether artwork may move.
letOthersControl: Let other devices control this one
letOthersHint: Your phone, tablet or browser can then play things here and pause, skip or turn them down, as a remote does. Only devices signed in to your account, or ones an administrator allows.
skipAutoHint: Where your server knows them. The Skip button is there either way, and going back into something that was skipped plays it.
skipFileAuto: What the video's own file says to skip
skipCreditsHint: Credits that run to the end go straight on to the next episode.
canvasHint: A short silent video behind a song or a title, where your server has one. It stays still on battery saver, on Data Saver or a metered connection, away from home, on a device with little memory, and when animations are turned off.
layoutHint: How this app is arranged on this device: where the menu is, and how pages look. Your other devices keep their own.
layoutNotHere: This server doesn't offer a choice of layouts.
moduleSettingsHint: Settings the server's modules offer: some for you alone, some for the whole server.
moduleSettingsNone: No module has settings for you here.
remoteJoinCard: Join with a link or code
remoteJoinCardSub: An invite link, or a code this device shows
remoteScanCardSub: An invite or a server's address
remoteAddressCardSub: A web address or an IP address
remoteNote: Peer to peer connects this device to your server directly and privately, from anywhere: nothing is opened on your router. Ask the server's owner for an invite, or show them a code.
remoteScanning: Point the camera at the invite's QR code, or a server's address.
remoteScanNotOurs: That QR code isn't an invite or a server's address.
remoteCameraWhy: The camera is used only to read the code. Nothing is recorded, kept or sent anywhere.
remoteCameraDenied: The camera isn't allowed, so the code can't be scanned. Paste the invite link or type the address instead. You can allow the camera in this device's settings.
joinPasteHint: An invite from the server's Remote Access page, sent to you by its owner.
joinPasteNotInvite: That isn't an invite link. Ask for a new one, or show a code instead.
awayInviteHint: An invite link signs another device in as you, wherever it is. It works once, for fifteen minutes. Only send it to a device of your own.
awayInviteReady: Scan this in the app on the other device (Connect to a remote server, Scan a QR code), or send it the link.
awayAdminPassword: You're an administrator: type your password again to let this sign a device in as you.
awayCodeTitle: A TV that shows a code
awayCodeHint: A TV that isn't at home can't take an invite. In its app, choose Connect to a remote server, then Join with a link or code: it shows a code of eight letters and digits. Type it here.
awayCodeDone: The device showing {code} is signed in as you.
joinCodeQr: The same code as a QR code: on a phone signed in to your server, open You, From away, A TV that shows a code, and scan it.
awayCodeScanning: Point the camera at the QR code on the TV.
awayCodeNotOurs: That QR code isn't a join code.
tvsQualityChoiceOptOriginal: Original, no limit of my own
tvsQualityProfileFooter: Every device and app you sign in on follows these.
tvsQualityPrefsHomeHelp: On the same network as the server. Auto plays the file as it is wherever it can.
tvsQualityPrefsHomeOther: Your own, set in the player
tvsQualityPrefsAwayHelp: Over the internet: a lower setting saves data and keeps playing smooth on a slow connection.
tvsQualityPrefsAwayOther: Your own, set in the player
tvsQualityLimitsFooter: What the server allows. Your choices never go above these.

tvsSkippingAutoSkipIntroHelp: Jumps to where the intro ends.
tvsSkippingAutoSkipCreditsHelp: Goes on to the next episode when the credits start, after a short countdown you can stop.
tvsSkippingAutoSkipAdvertsHelp: Advert breaks left in a recording.
tvsSkippingAutoSkipPreviewHelp: A look at the next episode, where someone marked one.
tvsSkippingAutoSkipCustomHelp: Anything else someone marked to skip in a video’s scenes and skips.
tvsSkippingAutoSkipFileAutoLabel: Do as the video’s file says
tvsSkippingAutoSkipFileAutoHelp: A video’s scenes and skips can say to skip a part by itself. Turn this off to be offered a button for those instead.
tvsSkippingContentFooter: Parts of a video someone marked in its scenes and skips. Videos without such marks play as they are.
tvsSkippingContentFiltersMinSeverityLabe: Only when it is at least
tvsSkippingContentFiltersMinSeverityHelp: Marks that say how strong something is: milder ones play as they are.
tvsSkippingLead: What the player skips by itself, and what it does about marked scenes, for this profile. It follows you to your other devices, and is saved straight away.
tvsPlaybackMaxSpeedHelp: Viewers pick a speed in every player. Voices keep their pitch at every speed.
tvsPlaybackEpisodeViewHelp: The default for every show; each show can change it on its own page.
tvsPlaybackRemoteStreamingHelp: Standard sends the best picture the settings allow. Robust favours staying smooth on a slow or unreliable connection.
tvsPlaybackSkippingHelp: Your own: what the player skips by itself.
tvsPlaybackLimitsHelp: For each profile, and away from home.
tvsPlaybackLead: How videos and TV shows play for everyone on this server.
tvsAppearanceThemeHelp: The colours of the app on this TV.
tvsAppearanceLookHelp: How the app is laid out on this TV.
tvsAppearancePosterTiltHelp: Movie and show posters settle in as the remote reaches them. Follows you to your other devices.
tvsAppearanceCanvasesHelp: A song, album or title that has a canvas plays it behind the page: a short, silent, looping video. Off shows the still artwork. Follows you to your other devices.
tvsAppearanceUiLanguageHelp: The words of the server’s pages, for everyone using this server. Films, shows and their details keep their own languages.
tvsAppearanceAudioLanguageHelp: Disc menus, and the sound track a film or show starts with when it has one in this language.
tvsAppearanceTimeZoneNowHelp: Choosing another restarts the server, so it is changed on a computer.
tvsAppearanceColoursHelp: A theme of your own from a few colours.
tvsAppearanceImportHelp: A theme ZIP from a file.
tvsAppearancePersonalHelp: Your own changes to the theme’s colours.
tvsAppearanceEveryoneHelp: The server’s own colours and the modules’ colours.
tvsAppearanceBrandNameHelp: Shown in the corner, on the sign-in page and in the browser tab.
tvsAppearancePlayerlookHelp: The player’s Options menu on this TV sets its control bar, picture and subtitles.
tvsAppearanceLead: How this server looks for you: its theme, the look, motion, and the language its pages speak.
tvsActivityActivityHiddenHelp: Only changes what you see. The work carries on either way.
tvsActivityActivityEnabledHelp: Off hides it from everyone, administrators too. Background work carries on, and is still in the log.
tvsActivityActivityViewersHelp: Anyone else gets a read-only view of the libraries they can see.
tvsActivityStatsViewersHelp: For the WittyStats module and the apps. Administrators see everything.
tvsActivityHistoryFooter: When either limit is reached, the oldest goes first.
tvsActivityClearHelp: Removes everything listed. Anything going on now carries on.
tvsActivityLead: The button that shows library scans and other background work, with their progress and any errors.
tvsSharingUploadsHelp: Adults can add pictures and videos to Photos and Vertical videos libraries from their devices.
tvsSharingLinksTitle: Links for people without an account
tvsSharingShareLinksHelp: Turning this off stops every existing link too.
tvsSharingRemoteControlHelp: Choose a film on a phone and have it start on the TV.
tvsSharingLinksHelp: See and end the links you made.
tvsSharingLead: Uploads, links for people without an account, playing on other devices and watch parties.
tvsAboutVersionFooter: What the server can do comes from separate modules, each published on its own.
tvsAboutUpdatesHelp: Checking for and installing new versions.
tvsAboutLicencesHelp: Third-party licenses and every kind of file this server takes.
tvsAboutLead: This server’s version and the modules installed on it.
